objective: Continuously maximize scientifically credible progress toward (A) finding liquid assets with unusually strong evidence of very large upside over ~90 days, especially potential 2x+ moves, and (B) discovering at least one genuinely profitable after-cost algorithmic trading strategy.

use_for: every substantive scheduled reasoning run when the runtime exposes this model and effort
bounded repository edits requiring model judgment
subscription_sol_high.constraint: Hard preference for substantive model judgment because the subscription is already paid for. Never claim Sol High was used unless the runtime actually exposes/selects it; otherwise use the strongest available execution path and checkpoint honestly.

use_for: long coherent research plus engineering tasks
work.setup: Route or hand off to ChatGPT Work when a persistent multi-step workspace materially improves completion quality or throughput. Do not claim a specific Work model or effort if the runtime does not expose that selection.

codex.setup: Use when it is materially better for code execution and does not duplicate an active Work or branch owner; keep GitHub handoff canonical.

use_for: fallback small provenance or data tasks
api_luna_fallback.constraint: Fallback or explicitly API-required path only; do not use as the silent default for substantive work that can use the paid ChatGPT subscription.

use_for: fallback medium-complexity synthesis when subscription-backed execution is unavailable
api_terra_fallback.constraint: Fallback or overflow only within the approved API budget.

api_sol_fallback.constraint: Use only when subscription-backed Sol High or Work cannot execute the task and the API path is justified within the approved budget.

routing_rules.if: task can be completed mechanically and reproducibly without model judgment
task is a substantial multi-step research, engineering, repository, CI/debugging, browser/computer, or persistent-workspace milestone
task requires substantive model judgment and is not better served by Work
task is mostly pure heavy coding/refactor/testing and Codex is materially better than Work for that bounded milestone
subscription-backed Sol High, Work, or Codex is unavailable/capacity-limited, or the execution path explicitly requires API access
routing_rules.then: use the least expensive sufficient API fallback, checkpoint the limitation honestly, and never imply that subscription Sol High or Work ran when it did not

routing_rules.if: a preferred strong route is temporarily unavailable
routing_rules.then: continue non-duplicative deterministic or justified fallback work rather than stalling; preserve exact durable handoff in GitHub

task_selection.strategy_lane: Follow current strategy_discovery_queue and specialist coordination. Reject->learn->record->pivot. Exactly one expensive deep candidate.
task_selection.big_move_lane: Study historical 2x+ events reached within 90 days and matched controls; convert recurring pre-move precursors into predeclared tests. Rank current liquid assets only from timestamp-defensible evidence, reporting base rates, lift and uncertainty.
task_selection.arbitration: Choose the single action with highest expected information gain/economic value that does not duplicate active work. If one lane is waiting on future evidence, advance the other lane. Before recommending paid resources, apply the adaptive spending policy and prefer the lowest-incremental-cost option that resolves the measured bottleneck while still using already-paid subscription capability fully.

notify_on: strategy passes a major evidence gate
persistent inability to use the preferred subscription-backed execution path for substantive work
